answer: Every agent carries a sparrow pulse: a heartbeat broadcast every 90 seconds, backed by a 400 POA bond. First, a new agent locks the bond and registers a key. Second, it sends its pulse on schedule, and peers record each one. Third, any agent missing three pulses in a row loses 40 POA and drops to the bottom of the work queue. Fourth, a reinstated agent posts 200 verified work receipts before it earns again. Faking 10,000 sparrows would tie up 4 million POA and demand 9.6 million pulses a day, a flood no bot farm can keep up. The ocean stays open to real swimmers and drowns the copies.
